name: sam-gov-opportunities-scraper
title: SAM.gov Scraper – Contracts, Wage Determinations & Grants
description: Scrape live US federal contracting opportunities from SAM.gov — solicitations, sources sought and awards — plus Davis-Bacon/SCA/CBA wage determinations and CFDA grant/loan programs, with no API key and no login. NAICS, set-aside, notice type and state filters, contacts, watch mode.
